data.cultural_impact: The Islamic title "Sayyida" is an honorific title that is commonly given to women who are considered to be of significant religious, spiritual, or cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is used as a title of respect and admiration, often given to the wives of Prophets, honored Sufi saints, and other revered Islamic figures. (Source: IslamiCity.net)
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the title "Sayyida" holds immense reverence and significance for Muslims. It signifies a deep connection to the divine and the recognition of the holy status of the woman bearing the title. It is a reminder of the special role that women play in the Islamic faith and the esteem in which they are held in the eyes of Allah and the community. (Source: MuslimMother.com)
